name: DoorDigest
tagline: AI summaries of every doorbell event.
meta_desc: DoorDigest reads your Ring doorbell events and writes you a clear daily summary — so you know exactly what happened at your door without scrubbing footage.
hero_eyebrow: iOS & Android · Works with your Ring
lead: DoorDigest watches your Ring events, picks out what mattered, and sends you a clear, written summary every day. Less paranoia, less footage, more peace of mind.

how_lead: We do the watching. You read a clean summary on your terms — daily, weekly, or only when something actually matters.
steps: One-tap login to your Ring account. We pull events securely and respect your existing subscriptions and recordings.
Every clip is analysed: people, packages, vehicles, animals, time of day, length of stay. The boring 99% gets summarised; the interesting 1% gets flagged.
Daily digest in plain English. Optional smart alerts the moment something unusual happens. Search history any time.
features: Each event gets a one-line description. 'Amazon driver, 4s on porch, package left.' That's it.

why_head_pre: Doorbell apps were built to grab your attention.
why_lead: Most camera apps poke you for every twitch — every neighbour's cat, every car turning around, every leaf blowing past. The result isn't more security; it's banner-ad fatigue.
why_body: DoorDigest takes the firehose, sips it, and tells you what's there. The only alerts that survive are the ones you'd genuinely want at 11pm.
stats: Of doorbell events most homes don't actually need to see in real time.
Average time to read your daily digest. Replaces 10 minutes of scrubbing.
Footage stays on Ring. We process metadata and a small preview strip.
faq: No — Ring keeps the cameras and footage. DoorDigest sits on top, watches what comes in, and writes the summary you actually read.
Only thumbnails and metadata, briefly, to generate the digest. Long-term footage stays on Ring's servers.
Will I miss a real emergency?
Smart alerts fire in real time on suspicious activity (late-night visitors, package thefts, repeated unknowns). Everything else is in the digest.
We get the obvious right (deliveries, post, family) reliably. Edge cases get flagged for your review rather than guessed at.
How many cameras can I connect?
Free: one. Pro: as many as your Ring account has.
Yes — through your phone's subscription settings. Your digests stay accessible until your billing period ends.
Does it work with cameras other than Ring?
Ring first — Nest and Eufy support is in beta for Pro users. Tell us your setup and we'll prioritise.
final_body: Free to download. iPhone and Android. Connect Ring once and stop scrubbing footage forever.
